name: LitigationExposureRegister
tagline: Litigation register with exposure, probability, IAS 37 / ASC 450 provisions and disclosure in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete litigation register for in-house legal and finance: matters, stages, courts and counsel; loss ranges, best estimates and probability; the required provision under IFRS IAS 37 or US GAAP ASC 450-20 against the provision booked; material contingent liabilities to disclose; quarterly review cycle; key dates and defence spend. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen, model-driven form or Power Pages page.
features: IFRS IAS 37 and US GAAP ASC 450-20 provision rules
Provision reconciliation with book / release and audit trail
Probability × exposure matrix with configurable bands
Quarterly review queue with bulk confirmation
Stage rules for trial, settlement and closing
Key dates, budget warnings, insurance and net exposure
Undo, bulk actions, filters, grouping, CSV export
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
Power Fx outputs and events; Dataverse and Power Pages Web API
